purpose: Chart 图表: the reference 4.0.0 Chart (added in 3.0.0) — 19 statistical chart kinds sharing a legend, tooltip, keyboard reading, data detail table and empty state, drawn with Flutter painting instead of SVG; no remote data.

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandChart](../../lib/src/components/chart/chart.dart) and the data model in [model.dart](../../lib/src/components/chart/model.dart): IslandChartData (one named constructor per IslandChartType: column, bar, line, area, mount, mix, radar take IslandChartSeries; scatter, bubble, time take IslandChartPointSeries; candle takes IslandChartCandleSeries; pie, ring, rose, funnel, word take one IslandChartSeries; map takes one IslandChartSeries plus IslandChartRegion outlines; arcbar and gauge take IslandChartSeries with min 0 / max 100), IslandChartValue, IslandChartPoint, IslandChartCandle, IslandChartSeriesMode, IslandChartTooltip, IslandChartTooltipTrigger. Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list.
interface.outputs: onDataActivate(IslandChartDataEvent) on click, Enter or Space with the original series/data indices, names, value (y for points, close for candles) and the caller's datum. A tooltip builder receives IslandChartTooltipContext (name, locked, items with colour, formatted value, share and funnel conversion).
interface.state_model: Data is derived on every build from IslandChartData (treated as immutable). The component owns: hidden legend keys (type + series name, plus index + name for item legends), the hovered reading, the keyboard-focused reading, the locked reading, the hovered/focused legend entry and the data table disclosure. Loading clears hover, focus and lock; a lock whose identity (type, series name, datum name, mark key) disappears is cleared and does not return when the datum comes back; a same-identity update keeps it with the new value. The active reading is the lock, else the hovered, else the focused reading.
interface.events: Click or Enter/Space on a reading calls onDataActivate and, when selectable, toggles the lock. Clicking empty plot space, the 解除锁定 pill, Escape anywhere inside the chart, an arrow/Home/End key, toggling a legend or restoring legends clears hover, focus reading and lock.
interface.composition: Parent owns width and placement. The container fills the available width with 20px padding (12px when the window is at most 480 wide), 1.5px border, radius 20. The plot is max(280, viewport width) wide (640 when unbounded) and scrolls horizontally inside narrower parents; its height is max(180, height), 300 for non-finite heights. Header (title 17/800, description 12/1.7) above; legend (wrapping 32px pills, 12×8 gaps), selection bar, data table and the word-cloud note below, in reference order.
interface.accessibility: The chart is a semantics container named semanticLabel ?? title ?? 统计图表, containing a plot group of the same name. Each reading is a focusable button named '{series}，{name}，{reading}' where the reading is the formatted value, 'x · y' (plus ' · 权重 w' for bubbles; time x as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or xFormatter) or '开 o / 收 c / 低 l / 高 h'; when selectable it carries a toggled state (aria-pressed). One roving Tab stop (the focused reading, else the first); arrows cycle, Home/End jump; Tab leaves to the legend. Keyboard focus draws a 2px outline 4px outside the mark; pointer focus does not (focus-visible). Legend entries are toggle buttons named by their text inside a group named 图例; 恢复全部图例 stays reachable while every entry is hidden. The data table (查看数据（N）, an expandable button) lists every valid datum including hidden ones and omitted words, captioned '{label}数据明细'. Loading and empty states are live regions. The tooltip panel is a live region. Screen-reader execution is excluded by the 2026-10-17 user scope decision.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese chrome strings (正在整理数据…, 暂无数据, 所有图例已隐藏, 恢复图例后，即可继续查看统计。, 请提供地图区域轮廓, 恢复全部图例, 已锁定, 已锁定：, 解除锁定, 点击锁定读数, 再次点击或按 Esc 解除锁定, 占比, 较首阶段, 较上阶段, 合计, 开/收/低/高, 权重, 查看数据（N）, 系列/项目/数值, 数据明细, 统计图表, 图例, 部分词条未能放入当前绘图区，完整数值可展开查看数据。). Default number format is zh-CN with up to two decimals and 万/亿/万亿 compact notation from 10 000; time axes default to local HH:mm.
interface.lifecycle: The component owns and disposes one focus node per reading (stale nodes are disposed after the frame that drops them), the fade and emphasis controllers and the plot scroll controller.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned recipe (lib/src/foundation/recipes/chart.dart, ChartColors.of(brightness)) maps the reference theme variables: light = reference default theme (#f8f8f0 surface, #794f27 ink, #e8e2d6 border/grid, #c4b89e zero line, #f0e8d8 legend pill, #e8e2d6 hover); dark = the dark product roles. Measured-colour rule applied (docs/DESIGN.md): secondary text #9f927d → #7d705c (light), focus #19c8b9 → #04a195 (light), hidden legend label (reference 0.5 opacity, 2.2:1) → opaque #7f6a51 over the half-opacity pill, rising candle #dc7367 → #da7166 (light), gauge needle #725d42 → #937d61 (dark), default series palette light mint/peach/green/purple/yellow/blue/pink → #03a193/#cc7b50/#639d64/#a87fc8/#b4890c/#7292b7/#c7798b (brown #9a835a kept); dark keeps the reference palette. Decorative grid, zero line, crosshair, separators (#fffdf7), gauge track (#eae2ce) and ticks (#b6a184) and empty map regions keep the reference. Caller series/point colours and the backgroundColor/borderColor overrides are caller-owned. Geometry ports Cartesian.tsx, Polar.tsx, Specialty.tsx and geometry.ts numerically (margins 62/90 left, 24 right, 28 top, 44 bottom; 0.7-slot bars capped at 42 and 0.86 drawn; radius 9 bars, 2 stacked; 3px lines; 0.18 area; 0.55 bubble/funnel; 1/2/2.5/5 automatic ticks). Unrelated marks and layers dim to 0.24 and active readings gain a 0 2 3 drop shadow over 200ms (library easing); the plot fades in over 250ms; legend pills lift 1px on hover over 200ms. Reduced motion settles every state immediately and removes the lift.
interface.performance: Scene geometry is recomputed per build (O(points); word cloud O(words × 1200) placement attempts per size step). Platform profiling required before release; intended for dashboard-sized data.
interface.migration: New component; no previous Flutter API.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference 4.0.0 Chart overview and its 19 type pages
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry and interaction agree; registered accessibility colour differences apply; other differences remain failures.

scenarios.given: A known dataset for each of the 19 kinds at the default height
scenarios.then: Mark rectangles, centres, sector containment, arc end points, funnel bands, word placement and map projection equal the reference formulas evaluated for the measured plot width.

scenarios.given: null, NaN, infinite values, incomplete coordinates, non-positive bubble weights, inconsistent candles and negative proportions
scenarios.then: Invalid data is neither drawn nor counted, keeps its index, and zero stays a reading; category lines break at gaps; incomplete radar series draw points without a polygon.

scenarios.given: Category, time, radar, scatter and item charts
scenarios.when: Hover, focus or activate a reading
scenarios.then: Axis tooltips compare every visible series at the same category, timestamp or dimension; item charts and trigger item show one reading; pie/ring/rose show shares of the drawn total and funnels rates against the first and preceding visible stage; a builder replaces the content and null hides it; tooltip null hides panel and guides.

scenarios.when: Click or Enter/Space a reading, then hover elsewhere, press an arrow key, Escape, or click empty space
scenarios.then: The lock keeps its reading during hover; activating it again, an arrow key, Escape, empty space or 解除锁定 release it; onDataActivate fires on every activation.

scenarios.given: Series legends (Cartesian, radar, gauge) and item legends (pie, ring, rose, funnel, word, map)
scenarios.then: Hover/focus dims other series or items; toggling hides/shows data and clears readings; hiding everything shows 所有图例已隐藏 with a restore action and keeps the data table.

scenarios.given: No drawable data, all legends hidden, a map without regions, or loading
scenarios.then: A small IslandNoData explains 暂无数据, 所有图例已隐藏 or 请提供地图区域轮廓; empty replaces only the plain empty state; loading shows 正在整理数据… without plot or data table.
Surface, border, grid, axis text, legend, tooltip, data table and empty state follow the theme; text keeps 4.5:1 and default series colours 3:1 on the surface.

scenarios.when: Mount, hover a legend, focus or lock a reading
scenarios.then: The plot appears at full opacity and emphasis settles in the same frame with the same states.
